messages.text: Talk to your agent from anywhere. Connect a channel to start sending and receiving messages.
Receive and respond to customer messages via your own WhatsApp number.
Chat with customers via Telegram bot.
Receive @-mentions and DMs via a registered Azure Bot (Bot Framework).
Receive @-mentions and DMs via a Slack app in Socket Mode.
Numeric Telegram user IDs only - the bot ignores everyone else. Leave empty to lock to you automatically once you first message the bot.
Slack user IDs only - the bot ignores everyone else. Leave empty to lock to you automatically once you first message the bot.

Create a Slack app with Socket Mode enabled. Make sure to create the slack app with "App Manifest (JSON)", then copy its Bot User OAuth token (xoxb-…) and an App-level token (xapp-…, scope connections:write) into the fields above. Click Connect to save.

Each channel replies on a fast model by default so responses stay snappy. Override a channel to a specific model - including any connected DeepSeek / Claude / OpenAI model. Flagship models reply more slowly on channels.
